question:
In the following sentence the underlined part contains an error. Alternatives to the underlined part are given as options. Select the correct alternative.

Yesterday was the __worse__ day of my life.
solution:
The correct answer is '3' i.e. worst .

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The given sentence talks about a particular day in the past that was extremely bad, hence it requires the superlative form of the adjective.
 
• The word "worse" is the comparative form of "bad," while "worst" is the superlative form.
 
• Since the sentence states that it was the single most bad day, the correct word to use is "worst".

Correct sentence: *Yesterday was the worst day of my life*.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Comparative and Superlative Forms:**

 
 
• **Comparative:** Used to compare two things. Example: "better" is the comparative form of "good."
 
• **Superlative:** Used to describe the highest degree of something among three or more things. Example: "best" is the superlative form of "good."
